Partial shipments shall be permitted only with Buyer's prior written consent, and each partial shipment shall be separately invoiced. Risk of loss shall pass to Buyer upon confirmed receipt at the designated facility, and Supplier shall retain risk of loss for all goods in transit prior to that point. Title to the goods shall pass to Buyer upon full payment of the applicable invoice, notwithstanding the earlier passage of risk of loss, and Supplier shall retain a purchase money security interest in the goods until such payment is received in full. Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance covering loss or damage to goods in transit and shall provide evidence of such coverage to Buyer upon reasonable written request.

Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at Supplier's option, repair, replacement, or refund of the purchase price for the nonconforming goods, provided that Buyer notifies Supplier in writing within 14 days of discovering the defect. Supplier shall bear the cost of shipping any repaired or replacement goods to Buyer, and Buyer shall grant Supplier reasonable access to inspect the nonconforming goods prior to any repair, replacement, or refund. Supplier shall invoice Buyer upon shipment, and payment shall be due forty-five (45) days from the date of each invoice.
